---
name: Hardware report
about: A camera, telescope or platform other than the one this grew on
labels: hardware
---

This project grew out of one telescope, one camera and one back garden, so
measurements from different hardware are the most valuable thing anyone can
send.

**The hardware.** Camera, sensor, telescope, focal length, mount or platform.

**What worked, and what did not.** Be specific about what broke: refused to
open, wrong colours, frames rejected, the field of view computed wrongly.

**Numbers, if you have them.** `astrodoro info`, `astrodoro bench`,
`astrodoro sensor` and `astrodoro usb` all print measurements. A number from a
different camera, or one that disagrees with what this program assumes, is
exactly what the project needs.
